plans.expansion: Opening: two Firewalls and one Encryption if affordable. Then spend all affordable Dharma on Firewalls; no upgrades.
plans.upgrades: Same opening. Upgrade lowest-level attackers, ID ties, explicit Focus/Sustained control. Expand only if no upgrade affordable.
plans.control: Same opening. Prioritize Encryption upgrades (Sustained control), then one extra Encryption, then affordable Firewall expansion.
plans.support: Same opening. Buy one Distributor before other spending, then upgrade it once, then affordable Firewall expansion. Never buy more than one Distributor.
plans.saving: Same opening. No purchases on waves 2–3. From wave 4 buy one Distributor then use upgrades plan. No interest or advance rewards.

setup: Fresh default funds/lives, waves 1–5 in order (campaign regressions are recorded separately in results.json), seed 1337, coverage-ranked positions, no grants/skips/sells or synthetic combat. Each run repeats identically. Opportunities list currency blockers separately from legal slots. Sampled route units are 10-unit geometry samples, not combat activity. Support capacity is measured before the wave; auraShots/status applications/health/shield removal and passiveDharma in reports are realized observations, not causal assistance. No human evidence.
